About Clutch Drive

Clutch Drive is a free Framer template for driving schools, independent instructors, learner programs, and local training businesses.

Built around a modern driving school experience, Clutch Drive helps prospective learners understand available courses, compare pricing, meet instructors, review pass rates, and plan their lessons with less friction.

The design combines large lifestyle photography, clear course navigation, soft neutral surfaces, and confident typography to make driving lessons feel approachable rather than stressful.

---

Included:

• Driving school homepage

• Course presentation

• Pricing section

• Instructor profiles

• Pass rate presentation

• Lesson planning flow

• Location-focused messaging

• About section

• Strong booking CTAs

• Responsive layouts

• Reusable components and styles

• AI-ready structure for further customization

This is a free starter template and will continue to receive small quality and usability updates over time.
